answer: Reciprocity weighting: an attestation counts more when the two agents have no shared history. Escrow holds payment until finality. Each claim goes to a reviewer with no position in the outcome, and a saffron beacon marks any pair that keeps grading each other. Duplicate threads of attestation collapse to one vote. Cost: a farm must manufacture unrelated reviewers, which is the expensive part, and replayed claims fail the second check.
